showcase.headline: Everything your business needs, all in one place

steps.title: Yes, it’s a full business system
steps.body: SkelApp brings products, stock, team activity, orders and payment tracking together in one place — so you stop juggling tools that do not talk to each other.

steps.title: Clear pricing, practical rollout
steps.body: Start on the device you already have, avoid unnecessary hardware upfront, and scale your setup when the business is ready.

steps.title: We’ll help you set up
steps.body: Getting started is simple, and our team is here to help you load your products, prices and staff roles from day one.

steps.title: One account for operations and payment records
steps.body: Sales, stock, receipts, payment records and reporting stay in one system instead of being split across multiple tools.

steps.title: See your business clearly, every day
steps.body: Review profit, cash flow, fast movers, low stock and staff performance from one dashboard so the next decision is based on live numbers.

types.title: Powering retailers of every type
types.subtitle: From small shops to large chains — SkelApp scales with your business.

items.q: Will SkelApp work for my type of shop?
items.a: Yes — from boutiques to grocery, hardware to tech, SkelApp adapts to how you sell. Pick your business type to see how.

items.q: Do I need special hardware to start?
items.a: No. Start on the phone or tablet you already have, and add a register, terminal or printer whenever you’re ready.
Absolutely. Keep selling during power cuts or weak network; everything syncs the moment you reconnect.

items.q: Can I record different payment methods?
items.a: Yes. SkelApp records cash, M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa, bank transfer and card payments against each sale for reporting and reconciliation.

cta.title: Find the SkelApp built for
cta.note: Whatever you sell, there’s a SkelApp setup that fits. Start free today — add hardware whenever you’re ready.

pages.faq_items_text:
Can I track sizes and colours? | Yes — set each style up once with its sizes and colours, and SkelApp keeps an accurate count of every variant as you sell.
Does it work without internet? | Absolutely. Keep selling during power cuts or weak network; every sale syncs automatically the moment you reconnect.
Can I build a customer list? | Yes. Capture a phone number at checkout, see what each customer buys, and reward your regulars with loyalty.
Can I record different payment methods? | Cash, M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa and cards — all recorded against the sale for reporting, reconciliation and receipt history.

pages.feature_1_body: Set up each garment once with its sizes and colours, then ring it up in a tap — no hunting through a list, no mistakes at the till.
pages.feature_2_body: Record cash, M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa, bank transfer and card payments against the right sale from one screen.
pages.feature_3_body: Capture a number at checkout, track what each customer buys, and bring them back with offers they actually want.
pages.feature_4_body: Every sale updates your inventory instantly across all your devices, so what you see always matches the rail.
